# The Books of Shadows

**Status:** `OPERATOR_CANON | ACCEPTED_2026-07-29`

The Books of Shadows are plural because the level population is not fixed:

```text
SHADOWS = N x (-,.,+)
```

The ASCII operator spelling `(-,.,+)` is preserved. The centre dot may also be rendered
`(-,·,+)` for display, but the display substitution does not change the operator token.
This is not flattened into one scalar multiplication. It records `N` addressed shadow
levels, each retaining minus, centre, and plus direction.

## Levels are gained according to need

```text
N_shadow(IS)      = AS_MANY_AS_NEEDED
N_translucent(IS) = AS_MANY_AS_NEEDED
GAIN(level)       = WHEN_NEEDED
```

Shadow levels and translucent levels are separate populations. They may be related, but
neither count is substituted for the other and neither has a ceiling inferred from a
small-N test. “As needed” is demand-driven in operator canon; an executable allocation rule
remains open until an owning system contract binds `NEED`.

## The speakers and the carrier

The electrons and shadows are the speaking voice of this book. Electron movement,
color-keyed state change, shadow direction, translucency, and level identity remain
separate axes. A color key can select a state without turning a shadow into an electron or
a translucent level into a raw RGB value.

The moving carrier passes onward as:

```text
1 -> prism/wave -> plural 0s -> span out -> instant reevaporation
  -> replenish MOVING_IS
```

## Refinement makes smaller color gradients

```text
MORE(SPACE)
  -> MORE(VACUUM_PRESSURE)
  -> MORE(REFINEMENT_REQUIRED)
  -> SMALLER(COLOR_GRADIENTS)
```

“Smaller colors” is preserved as finer color-gradient address resolution. It is not
silently converted into smaller photons, shorter wavelengths, lower energy, fewer RGB
values, or a smaller color gamut. Gradient address, energy sign, color key, and physical
wavelength remain separate ledgers.

The refined gradients carry the speaking direction:

```text
COLOR / ENERGY: negative -> centre -> positive
FROM_WITHIN(IS) -> WASes and WILLs  [INSTANT]
FROM_WITHOUT     -> absorbed by IS  [INSTANT]
```

See [[LAW-70-LEVELS-OF-SHADOW-CATS]] for a narrower measured operator spectrum and
[[LAW-71-HOTTER-BLACK-SHADOW-CAT-SPHERICAL-AMPLIFICATION]] for prior hot-black law. Those
laws are antecedent slices, not ceilings on this book's population.
